/**
 * File header, separated from the first export by a blank line, so it
 * does not count as that export's documentation.
 */

export const undocumentedConst = 1;

// A line comment is not a JSDoc comment.
export function undocumentedFunction(): number {
  return undocumentedConst;
}

/* A plain block comment is not a JSDoc comment either. */
export interface UndocumentedInterface {
  readonly value: number;
}

export type UndocumentedAlias = string | number;

/** Documented, but not directly above: a blank line separates them. */

export class UndocumentedClass {
  /** Documented method. */
  documented(): void {}

  undocumentedMethod(): number {
    return 1;
  }

  private hidden(): number {
    return 2;
  }

  #secret(): number {
    return 3;
  }

  static undocumentedStatic(): number {
    return 4;
  }
}

/** Documented function; its overload signatures below need no second comment. */
export function overloaded(value: string): string;
export function overloaded(value: number): number;
export function overloaded(value: string | number): string | number {
  return value;
}

function notExported(): void {}

export { notExported };
